segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hello, this is Neha from Kosha Capital. This call is recorded. I am calling about your monthly installment that was due on the fifth.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I already told your colleague yesterday, I will pay next week.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I understand. But the installment is overdue, and late charges are applying.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: This is ridiculous. How many times do I have to explain the same thing?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Sir, as per our policy, I need to remind you.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I lost my job last month and I simply cannot pay right now. You people keep calling me again and again.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Can you pay at least half of the amount today?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Are you even listening to me? This is so frustrating.
